observations: Photo 0: Black zoom lens held in hand, barrel marked with focal-length scale 12,15,17,20,24 and an aperture/distance window, 'SIGMA' text visible on the barrel, AF/M switch visible.
Photo 1: Front element and lens hood, wide-angle convex glass visible, no visible fungus or haze in the frame shown, hood attached.
Photo 2: Rear/mount end showing a label 'LENS MADE IN JAPAN' and a serial number '1016378'; the actual mount flange, contacts, or Canon EF red-dot indicator are not clearly visible.
No photo shows the rear bayonet/contacts clearly enough to confirm Canon EF mount.
No video or test shot showing autofocus, aperture blade movement, or zoom/focus ring smoothness.
No shot of the lens against a light source to check for internal dust, haze, fungus, or scratches.

identity.model: 12-24mm (markings visible, full model suffix e.g. EX DG HSM not legible)
read_from: photo 0 barrel markings and SIGMA text

claims.claim: US used Sigma 12-24mm lens for Canon camera
claims.evidence: Focal range 12-24 and Sigma branding are visible in photo 0, but Canon mount/contacts are not clearly shown in any photo; 'US used' origin cannot be confirmed from images.

claims.claim: Looks new and in perfect working condition
claims.evidence: No video of autofocus, zoom, or aperture operation; no clear glass-element shot to rule out fungus/haze/scratches.

risks.risk: Mount may not actually be Canon EF (seller's claim unconfirmed) or contacts could be damaged/corroded.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rear mount showing electronic contacts and the Canon EF red dot alignment marker.
risks.if_unproven: priced as mount-unverified, i.e. generic lens risk, not assumed Canon-compatible

risks.risk: Internal optical faults such as fungus, haze, or dust that reduce image quality.
risks.proof: Photo or video of the lens held up to a bright light showing the full optical path front to back.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible optical defects, i.e. not flawless

risks.risk: Autofocus motor or aperture blades may be faulty or sticky.
risks.proof: Short video showing autofocus engaging on a camera body and aperture blades stopping down.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working (AF/aperture assumed non-functional)

risks.risk: Zoom/focus ring may be stiff, loose, or have zoom creep.
risks.proof: Video of zoom ring being rotated through its full range and focus ring turning smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: priced as mechanically unverified, i.e. worst case of stiff/loose

proof_requests: Photo of the rear mount showing Canon EF contacts and red-dot index clearly.
Video of lens mounted on a Canon body showing autofocus and aperture operation.
Photo of the lens held against a bright light showing the full glass path for fungus/haze/dust.
Video of zoom and focus rings being operated through their full range.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Sigma 12-24mm lens from visible barrel markings and branding, but Canon-mount confirmation and functional condition remain unverified, so it must be priced at worst case among comparable Canon-mount lens listings.
